Quadrilateral A B C D is shown. Sides A D and B C are parallel. Sides A B and C D are congruent. Angle A is 115 degrees.
What is the measure of ADC in quadrilateral ABCD?

45°
65°
115°
135°
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 attempts to use the parallel-line and isosceles-trapezoid structure (AB ≅ CD with AD ∥ BC) and correctly infers that the base angle at D should equal angle A, but it incorrectly treats ∠ADC as supplementary to that angle, producing the wrong value (65 instead of 115). Candidate 2 only defines trapezoids and never computes the requested angle. Candidates 3 and 4 likewise do not solve the specific geometry problem and instead provide unrelated or generic angle-sum facts.
